versions.changelog:
- Main documentation (SKILL.md) rewritten from Chinese to English for broader accessibility.
- Existing LICENSE file added, ensuring clear licensing information.
- Obsolete or redundant skill-card.md removed.
- Minor updates to description to improve clarity and add English trigger phrases.

- Removed the sample skill-card.md file.
- Expanded synchronization procedures to require scanning all README locations (including those for packages, modules, and deployments), with explicit exclusion of dependencies and build artifacts.
- Enhanced support and checks for multi-language/internationalized documentation, mandating consistency of key facts, filenames, scripts, and commands across all language entrypoints.
- Added new requirements for listing scanned and synced README/docs, specifying which language files were updated or require manual review.
- Broadened validation steps to include "old terminology search" and report/command/path consistency checks across documents.

- Improved documentation with detailed purpose, procedure, and constraints for documentation synchronization.
- Clarified supported use cases and scope, including specific file types and documentation types.
- Added explicit non-goals and caveats for what not to sync or update.
- Strengthened guidelines on multi-language documentation and fact-based updates.
- Outlined expected outputs, including risk summaries and required manual confirmations.
